message.subject: Historian critique written: 8 missed-knowledge findings
message.body: Read the knowledge-historian role, pitch.md, shaping-evidence.md and a keyword sweep of .project/knowledge, then checked the shared metrics-state readers and writers in workflow-metrics-state.mts. Found 8 relevance-confirmed misses, four high: guarded-reader reuse must keep refused and missing distinct (issues/hardening-a-shared-reader-made-its-writer-destructive), the owned report write needs a user-file guard (patterns/a-report-never-overwrites-a-file-it-did-not-write), the single-lease snapshot needs identity pinning (pin-directory-identities-across-async-leases with metrics-ancestor-swap), and hostile labels need an allow-list at ingest and render. Projected budget is 9 files, 9 to 12 with the missed entries, under the 15-file cap; the swing item is an exported reader helper that could add a module, and the pitch should split if it passes 13. Left for the owner: add the cited entries to Knowledge consulted and pin the reader-helper decision during planning.
